The hue of the room gave it a warm feeling.

entries.definition_en: a sudden increase

entries.definition_en: having many parts; finely detailed
examples: The intricate design of the vase made it a valuable piece for her collection.
I cannot begin to understand all of the intricacies of modern automobile motors.

entries.definition_en: of great size or importance
examples: The magnitude of shock waves determines the damage that occurs during an earthquake.
The invention of the telephone was a magnificent achievement for mankind.

entries.definition_en: to have to do something

Payment of the student activity fee was obligatory .

entries.definition_en: to ignore or neglect
examples: Scientists must not overlook any aspect of experimental procedure.

entries.definition_en: convenient or effective

entries.definition_en: the most noticeable or powerful element

entries.definition_en: to cause something to happen; do quickly; be on time

Promptness is a valued trait in the professional world.

entries.definition_en: to cause or produce negative behavior or result

entries.definition_en: a quotation or mention, often of another person’s work
examples: J. K. Rowling often alludes to Greek and Roman mythology in her character names.

entries.definition_en: alike in some way
examples: The action of light waves is analogous to the action of sound waves.
The analogy between the behavior of the bacteria in the lab and in the human body is not clear.

entries.definition_en: to make something happen by necessity or force
examples: The representatives were compelled to vote in favor of the legislation despite their personal opposition to it.

entries.definition_en: to collect

The book is a compilation of Shakespeare’s plays.

entries.definition_en: difficult; causing worry or fear

entries.definition_en: the state of being inside when not desired to be there by others

entries.definition_en: occurring at specific, determined periods of time

entries.definition_en: likely to do something

entries.definition_en: correctly telling about future events

entries.definition_en: the relationship of size or importance when compared to another object or person

entries.definition_en: willingly; easily

Her readiness to cooperate was an important factor in the investigation.

entries.definition_en: in a trusted way

entries.definition_en: fame

entries.definition_en: to restore to life or bring back into memory

entries.definition_en: to be full of something; crowded

entries.definition_en: able to be done, usually referring to something you can do without damage or loss

entries.definition_en: to make something impure by adding something dirty or a poisonous substance

entries.definition_en: active and growing; healthy

entries.definition_en: not enough; unsatisfactory

entries.definition_en: to support; to keep in good condition

entries.definition_en: hardly noticeable; scarcely detectable

entries.definition_en: to give something or express a feeling in return

entries.definition_en: spread out or separated widely

entries.definition_en: a little

entries.definition_en: to emerge or develop from something

entries.definition_en: short, usually in time

entries.definition_en: drawing special attention to

entries.definition_en: having a tendency to do something; likely

entries.definition_en: things combined to make something; the contents of something

entries.definition_en: in an unthinking manner; not chosen

entries.definition_en: something that surprises or impresses

entries.definition_en: not too much, not too little;

entries.definition_en: to provide a reason or purpose for doing something

entries.definition_en: unusual

entries.definition_en: to be very generous, often in excess

entries.definition_en: a picture or element thrown back

The class assignment is to summarize the book’s plot as succinctly as possible.

entries.definition_en: according to reports or hearsay; widely believed or accepted

entries.definition_en: continuing in a constant way; remaining strong
examples: Sustained rainfall is the only hope they have for relief from the drought.
Luckily, the trees did not sustain any damage from the attack of the locusts.

entries.definition_en: the mixing of separate things to form a whole;
examples: The language of Papiamento is a synthesis of Dutch and native Indian languages of Curaçao.

entries.definition_en: real; that which can be felt

entries.definition_en: making worse; annoying

entries.definition_en: something that holds interest and is enjoyable

entries.definition_en: to change from one form or state to another

entries.definition_en: being able to restore to good condition

entries.definition_en: to sense; become aware of

Porpoises are very perceptive mammals.

entries.definition_en: the feeling of freedom from danger, doubt, or worry

entries.definition_en: the only one of its kind; extraordinary

entries.definition_en: harmful; capable of being fatal

entries.definition_en: calm; quietness

His tranquil manner of expression made us all feel more secure.

entries.definition_en: guessed lower than the actual quantity

entries.definition_en: to know, remember, and accept the existence of something

entries.definition_en: to gain or come to possess

entries.definition_en: a variety

entries.definition_en: to pay no attention
examples: They disregarded the no parking signs and were ticketed by the police.

entries.definition_en: having much monetary or sentimental value; beautiful

entries.definition_en: famous; having a high position

entries.definition_en: needed for a specific purpose;

entries.definition_en: experiencing few or no changes; not moving

entries.definition_en: very much; very large

entries.definition_en: intelligent; resourceful

entries.definition_en: extreme; harmful

entries.definition_en: not consistent; irregular

entries.definition_en: found everywhere

entries.definition_en: a joke; a funny story
